visualCharacteristics.purpose: Full-bleed photo call-to-action band with a text column on the left
visualCharacteristics.layout: Full-bleed photo band, 100px padding, left text column, primary button

contentPattern.structure: one row (cells in any order): picture (optional), h2 with <em> for the blue word, lede paragraph(s), bold CTA link

usage: Inspiration / formulation call-to-action band on about and contact pages.
reuseGuidance: Reuse cta-band for the same content pattern on newly migrated pages; add an option class rather than forking for small visual differences.
